description: Generate a reply from an AI model. Use when the app needs generated text. Before: a model id from list_ai_models and enough project balance. Returns the reply message, the tokens used (usage) and the amount charged: charge_usd_micro (millionths of a USD; charge_usd_minor, in cents, on the per-cent billing). Spends money: billed per token to the project balance at the price shown by get_pricing; the key's spending limit applies. Scope: ai:inference. Cost: paid, reserved on the prepaid balance before the call (released if it fails); prices: get_pricing. Short balance or limit: next_action top_up_balance or raise_app_spend_limit.

messages.content: Summarize this order in one sentence.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per request; reuse it on retry to get the same reply without paying twice.

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first (1 to 256 messages).

model.description: A model id exactly as list_ai_models returns it.

seed.description: Same seed and input for a repeatable reply.

stop.description: Up to 4 strings that end the reply.

temperature.description: Randomness, 0 to 2. Lower is more focused.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling, 0 to 1. Change this or temperature.

name: create_chat_completion
title: Ask an AI model
